scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] tracking-tighter leading-none font-black

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows instead of drop shadows (e.g., shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(212,175,55,0.1)]).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on dark backgrounds to simulate film/theatre grain.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[rgba(212,175,55,0.1)] saturate-150. CRITICAL: Never use fully transparent backgrounds over content.

layouts.hero: 100vh full-screen 3D canvas (React Three Fiber) + Absolute positioned Framer Motion text overlay. Staggered masked line-by-line reveal.
layouts.manifesto: Asymmetrical bento layout for numbered chapters. Generous p-12 to p-24 padding.
layouts.marquee: Slow-moving, editorial font, text-8xl outline text in the background.
layouts.featured_event: Deep crimson background section showcasing 'In the Heart of the Cross'. Overlapping 3D layered UI. Ticket purchase CTA.
layouts.grids: Dense tight gap-4 for video episodes. Asymmetrical gap-12 for stage productions.

motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll (MANDATORY) for premium momentum feeling.
motion.reveals: Framer motion line-by-line text masks. IntersectionObserver triggered y-axis lifts.
motion.hover: Subtle scale up, gold border glow on cards. Image scale up inside clipped frames.

3d_libraries.usage: Hero stage. Use <Canvas>, <PerspectiveCamera>, <SpotLight> with penumbra, and <Float>. Add a glowing 3D cross or theatrical lighting in the center. Allow orbit controls with restricted angles. Provide a dark cinematic feel.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or pill-shaped. Primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#E5A93C]. Secondary: transparent border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37].
components.cards: Dark flat rectangles, no standard shadow, 1px gold-tinted border.
components.forms: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Minimalist inputs with bottom borders only, or dark filled bg-[#121010] with focus:ring-[#D4AF37].

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #F5F2EB text over #0A0A0A meets APCA/WCAG standards. Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

media.adinkra_symbols: Use inline SVG code with gold (#D4AF37) fill for Adinkra motifs (e.g. Gye Nyame, Dwennimmen, Adinkrahene, Akoben) to represent power & authority. Use these as background watermarks, section dividers, or callout icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement Lenis smooth scrolling at the root of the app.

Build a Hero3D component (.jsx/.js, NOT .tsx) using React Three Fiber. Create a dark stage with a Spotlight, volumetric lighting or dust, and a central glowing object (like a subtle cross or stage prop). Allow constrained OrbitControls.
Overlay the Framer Motion text on the 3D Canvas. Animate the 'TRU SYDS LLC' hero text revealing line by line with a mask.
Implement the 'In the Heart of the Cross' featured event section with deep crimson accents, dramatic clouds/rays (use images or CSS gradients), and a 'Buy Tickets ($30)' Stripe checkout button.
Build a Contact Form and Newsletter signup with mocked DB saving and mock Stripe integration for donations/tickets.
Use vanilla HTML/Tailwind classes for creative asymmetric layouts. Do not rigidly use Shadcn Card components if they break the artistic flow.
Create the Numbered Manifesto Chapters for About/Mission/Vision/Core Values.
Use Playfair Display (Headings) and Outfit (Body). Load via Google Fonts.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' layouts. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Use high contrast, layered z-index hierarchy, and glass-morphism effects.
Do NOT center align the app container. Remove '.App { text-align: center; }'.
All interactive elements must include a 'data-testid' attribute.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui, but customize them to match the dark cinematic brand.
